name: mobimatch-monorepo
description: MobiMatch Monorepo: Backend API, Admin Android App, and User Android App

scripts.build: npm run --workspace=@mobimatch/api-contracts build && npm run --workspace=mobimatch-backend build
scripts.postinstall: npm run --workspace=@mobimatch/api-contracts build && npm run --workspace=mobimatch-backend build
scripts.backend:build: npm run --workspace=@mobimatch/api-contracts build && npm run --workspace=mobimatch-backend build
scripts.test: npm run --workspace=packages/api-contracts test && npm run --workspace=backend test
scripts.check:types: npm run --workspace=@mobimatch/api-contracts build && npm run --workspace=mobimatch-backend build && npx tsc --noEmit -p mobimatch/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p mobimatch-admin/tsconfig.json

author: MobiMatch Team
